description: Source file implementing the IPEndPoint class for handling IP address endpoints, including serialization, deserialization, and socket address conversions.

classes.name: IPEndPoint
classes.description: Represents an IP address endpoint with serialization, deserialization, and socket address conversion functionalities.

methods.name: FromValue
methods.description: Creates an IPEndPoint from a serialized base::Value dictionary.

methods.name: ToValue
methods.description: Serializes the IPEndPoint into a base::Value dictionary.

methods.name: GetForAllInterfaces
methods.description: Returns an IPEndPoint bound to all interfaces with specified port (Windows-specific).

methods.name: GetFamily
methods.description: Returns the address family of the IP address.

methods.name: GetSockAddrFamily
methods.description: Returns the socket address family constant.

methods.name: ToSockAddr
methods.description: Fills a sockaddr structure with the IP address and port.

methods.name: FromSockAddr
methods.description: Initializes IPEndPoint from a sockaddr structure.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the IP address with port.

methods.name: ToStringWithoutPort
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the IP address without port.
